event.name: Operational Recovery and Crew Data Platform Selection

knowledgeContext.frozenV1Status: EXISTING LIVE AIRLINE CORPUS RECONCILED THROUGH CUBE
knowledgeContext.limitation: Live Knowledge contains 10 interview rows; leadership/C-suite completeness is not certified.

requirements.statement: Protect irregular-operations recovery value with auditable decision support.
Reduce crew reassignment cycle time during disruption events.
Expose finance-ready value and cost attribution by operating lever.
Support crew legality, fatigue, and contract-rule checks in planning workflows.
Provide station, aircraft, and crew-state synchronization for recovery teams.
Support playbook execution with role-based action logs.
Maintain degraded-mode recovery workflow when an upstream feed is delayed.
Integrate with operations control, crew management, data platform, and notification services.
Use tenant-scoped APIs and avoid direct UI access to raw Knowledge tables.
Expose Source workflow state through SourceOperationalProvider.
Emit deterministic view models through SourceViewModelAssembler.
Resolve crew, flight, aircraft, station, and disruption entities with stable IDs.
Carry evidence references and known gaps for every decision-critical claim.
Support lineage from proposal response to evaluation score to recommendation.
Keep Source operational records separate from canonical Knowledge publications.
Enforce tenant isolation for records, artifacts, and generated Decision Briefs.
Support least-privilege evaluator access and audit logging.
Do not weaken storage, database, auth, or provider security controls.
Deliver a staged migration with parallel run and rollback checkpoints.
Provide training, transition commitments, and hypercare measures.
Demonstrate no SkyHarbor or non-airline tenant fallback in demo paths.
Normalize pricing across platform, implementation, support, and usage lines.
Tie BAFO changes to score, risk, and transition commitments.
Define service credits and value tracking for recovery performance.
